purpose: A new one-time confirmatory out-of-sample test of the already-frozen Risk Tool V2 15m/30m Severity ordering plus symmetric Platt calibration, using a post-preregistration window and the independently verified paired-symbol source family. This is a new scientific question and is not an extension or rescue of the revealed 2026 fresh-OOS test.

unchanged: frozen Phase-1 model identity and ridge lambda
same continuous AM/PM session and no lunch crossing
family size 2, one-sided alpha 0.05, lower quantile 0.025
changed_only: carrier-family authority and pre-activation snapshot binding

future_oos_window.reason_for_start: The scientific contract is frozen after the 2026-09-15 China-market session. Starting 2026-09-16 prevents any already elapsed 2026-09-14 or 2026-09-15 session from being retroactively represented as future OOS.

carrier_family_authority.binding_semantics: Future scientific input must be a new immutable snapshot of the same reviewed 5m offset-0 source family with independent valid bindings for both target symbols. The future snapshot is expected to have a new content identity because it must contain later data; the exact future bytes/SHA must be frozen before any row-level semantic read or scoring.

requirements_before_activation: one immutable new snapshot is pinned before any row-level scientific read
the snapshot belongs to the verified 5m offset-0 source family
both symbols cover every available trading session in the immutable 2026-09-16 through 2027-03-31 window
the snapshot bytes, SHA256, source-manifest identity, symbol coverage and schema mapping are frozen in a separate pre-activation record
no outcome, model score, acceptance metric or row-level market value is inspected before that pre-activation freeze
activation_gate.failure_to_meet_activation_gate: Do not execute the scientific test and do not shorten, extend, backfill, substitute or move the window. A changed window requires a new preregistration.

future_oos_acceptance_gates_per_horizon: family-adjusted trading-day bootstrap lower bound for raw-score AUROC gain > 0
fresh pooled calibrated Brier gain B-minus-C > 0
fresh pooled calibrated LogLoss gain B-minus-C > 0
each symbol calibrated Brier gain >= 0 and calibrated LogLoss gain >= 0

verdicts_per_horizon.FUTURE_OOS_SUPPORTED: All frozen support and scientific acceptance gates pass.
verdicts_per_horizon.FUTURE_OOS_NOT_SUPPORTED: Support is adequate but one or more frozen scientific acceptance gates fail.
verdicts_per_horizon.INSUFFICIENT_FUTURE_OOS_SUPPORT: One or more frozen support gates fail; this does not authorize changing the window, carrier family, model, calibration or gates.

authority_after_result.if_supported: The result may add fresh confirmatory evidence for the frozen 15m/30m Risk Tool V2 probability component. Any Layer3 strategy integration remains a separate research question and production_authority remains false.
authority_after_result.if_not_supported: The frozen component is not supported by this future OOS window; no rescue retuning on revealed future-OOS data is allowed.
authority_after_result.if_insufficient_support: The full window is considered revealed once evaluated; insufficient support does not authorize extending or moving the window. Another test requires another preregistration.
